about_the_game:
Stealer is a platformer with Metroidvania elements. You start the game as a thief who, just like you, understands nothing. As you explore the locations, you are immersed in darkness, but you have a precious lantern. Look for clues and interact with the environment to achieve your goals.

Game Difficulty

This is a challenging platformer. Don’t think you’ll be able to simply run past all the obstacles! Sometimes you can make things easier by tackling challenges wisely or even avoiding them altogether. However, this depends on your attentiveness and ability to analyze the situation. Stay alert and use your skills to successfully complete the game!

Interesting Mechanics

  • Stealing

To obtain the desired item, you need to steal it, and this doesn’t always happen quickly. Be cautious and calculated to ensure everything goes as planned.

  • Candles

Your path can be illuminated not only by the lantern but also by candles. However, remember that you’ll need matches for this, which are currently in short supply.

  • Lockpicking

You’re a thief, which means a locked door is no obstacle for you. So, pick those locks, but don’t forget about your lockpicks.

World Secrets

This world is far from as simple as it may seem at first glance. The lantern can’t always illuminate every corner or reveal all the secrets. Explore hidden rooms to find more valuable loot and uncover the mysteries lurking in the darkness.

Add to Your Wishlist

This is just a part of the aspects of our game that we’ve managed to share. To learn more, dive into the captivating world by playing our demo!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes featuring blood and depictions of corpses. These elements may be unsuitable for some players and could cause discomfort. We recommend considering this before starting the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E5200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 9800GTX+ (1GB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, 16:9 recommended
